newsitem.title: USA: CVS holders approve name change.
newsitem.headline: CVS holders approve name change.

text.p: Melville Corp said on Tuesday shareholders approved a name change to CVS Corp.

The company also said it plans to separate by no later than the end of 1997 its two other remaining businesses: Linens 'n Things and Bob's Stores, both of which are classified as discontinued operations.
The company said the name change reflects its new status as a stand-alone chain drug company, with CVS/pharmacy as its only continuing operation.
Shareholders also gave approval to reincorporate in Delaware.
